interpretation: Inventory disposition completeness is not complete semantic reading or executed verification.

C01.purpose: Current loader, global settings, policy and trust
C01.rationale: Decisive loader, writer, cache and admission branches read directly. These are the owned implementation authority; schema/registry membership alone is insufficient.
C01.next: For a change, preserve current/legacy decoding, global/project lifetime and consumer-specific permission separation; publisher changes require the unowned generator owner.

C02.purpose: Current configuration schema and markdown leaves
C02.rationale: Small owned schema/helper bodies individually read. They define shapes, parsing, annotations and constraints, not proof that downstream consumers execute every field.
C02.next: Follow the changed field into its actual consumer and legacy mapping; do not turn schema annotations into runtime guarantees.

C03.purpose: Live legacy decode and migration inputs
C03.rationale: Every upgrade leaf, source decoder and migration implementation was individually read. Config.needsUpgrade makes these live compatibility inputs.
C03.next: For a mapping change inspect paired legacy/current definitions and the specific migrate branch, including statement ordering and mixed current permissions.

C04.rationale: Each plugin and lowerer body was read; register/transform behavior is consumer-specific. Catalog data, API options and actual native Session support remain distinct.
C04.next: Follow affected registry consumer before asserting execution or provider compatibility; inspect real loader admission before enabling executable project content.

C05.rationale: Writers read directly: target selection, optional optimistic revision, confinement, formatting preservation and install boundary differ from global settings publication.
C05.next: Preserve each writer's actual target/revision rules; read caller validation and installer/entrypoint consumer for corresponding mutations.

C06.purpose: Behavior storage, feature flags and TUI discovery
C06.rationale: Owned supporting bodies read individually. Separate storage, flags and TUI discovery do not establish Core Config flag adoption or execution-host behavior.
C06.next: Trace actual flag consumers and behavior context producer; do not infer behavior from an exported flag alone.

P01.purpose: Project/Location identity, graph and directory membership
P01.rationale: Identity and graph bodies read, with exact Session placement boundary capture. Global project root, Location directory and project/directory membership are separate.
P01.next: Preserve process-global Session execution and Location-scoped services; unowned public Location schema belongs to its owner.

P02.rationale: Decisive physical/lexical boundary and mutation implementation read; helper/patch partial ranges are explicit. Permission derivation is not approval, and local locks are not cross-process atomicity.
P02.next: Before stronger OS safety claims inspect owned S1-01 runtime util/physical-path.ts and relevant caller authorization; read untouched patch/helper branches for behavior-specific changes.

P03.rationale: Full checkpoint implementation and SQL table read, including original-owner exact retry, digest, bounds and storage error sanitization.
P03.next: Semantic payload validation and actual restoration remain consumer responsibilities; targeted product checks require authorized CI.

P04.rationale: Strategy and decisive create/remove/refresh branches read. Physical operations and database membership are distinct effects.
P04.next: Read the omitted copy-name helper for naming changes, and actual Git/process implementation and assertions for worktree behavior changes.

P05.purpose: Git, snapshots, reference parsing and repository cache
P05.rationale: Snapshot and selected Git operation branches plus complete reference/cache bodies establish selective restore, mutable checkout reuse and refresh boundaries. Unread Git branches stay unclaimed.
P05.next: For the operation changed, inspect remaining Git branch and process/lock dependencies. Do not treat a mutable cache, digest or tree ID as a runtime proof.

P06.rationale: Selected cache/invalidation and bounded activity/diff ranges read; source reports truncation and empty/nonrepository cases.
P06.next: Read the specific omitted parsing/query branch and assertions before a behavior change; preserve output/time/commit bounds.

P07.purpose: Filesystem search, watcher and platform support
P07.rationale: Platform wrappers and filter bodies read; selected search/watcher setup/fallback/failure branches inspected. Scan filters do not provide authorization.
P07.next: Inspect platform/backend-specific search or watch branch for a corresponding change; availability and successful subscription need runtime evidence.

P08.purpose: External repository adapters and thin schema exports
P08.rationale: Guardrail/PR adapter ranges identify process and host boundary; file/workspace are thin exports. No external command or service was called.
P08.next: Follow selected adapter branch and external owner contract before execution; do not infer authentication or success from adapter presence.

D01.rationale: Project design and config review-label ranges establish intent and historical status. Remaining config-field prose is not promoted over current code.
D01.next: Use implementation/public Protocol sources for current behavior; read a historical section only when its decision context is needed.

T01.rationale: Tests support proposed verification, not runtime receipts. Captured/read case depth is recorded per row; uncaptured test filenames establish only inventory membership and family.
T01.next: Before a configuration-specific change read its relevant test assertions/fixtures and run only authorized repository CI; no test result is claimed here.

T02.rationale: Tests support targeted future checks. Only listed captured assertion ranges/declarations were inspected; all other tests remain inventory-only.
T02.next: Before a corresponding change inspect its relevant assertions/platform skips and run authorized repository CI; no local or remote product execution occurred.

F01.rationale: The single fixture is indexed as test support and uncaptured. No production behavior or fixture contents are asserted from its path.
F01.next: Read this fixture with its owning plugin test before modifying that test or plugin-loading behavior.
